Microsoft Certification Program

Azure · Power BI · MCT Collaboration

A focused preparation programme for Microsoft Azure and Power BI certifications, designed to bridge the gap between theoretical learning and industry-recognised credentials.

4–8 Weeks per Certification Online · Offline in Chennai Microsoft Certification (AI-900 / DP-900)
Register for Certification Prep → Programme details

Overview

A focused preparation programme for Microsoft Azure and Power BI certifications, designed to bridge the gap between theoretical learning and industry-recognised credentials. Delivered in collaboration with Microsoft Certified Trainers (MCTs), this programme combines exam-specific preparation with practical, hands-on labs — ensuring you understand both the concepts and the cloud platform deeply enough to excel in the certification exam and on the job.

Each certification track takes 4–8 weeks and prepares you for AI-900 (Azure AI Fundamentals), DP-900 (Azure Data Fundamentals) and PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), with AZ-900 available as an add-on. Sessions run live online and are recorded for replay, with offline bootcamps in Chennai; you get Azure portal labs, practice question banks, timed mock exams and guidance on vouchers and exam booking.

Programme Highlights

  • Taught in collaboration with Microsoft Certified Trainers (MCTs)
  • Hands-on Azure portal labs and real cloud exercises
  • Domain-specific practice question banks per certification
  • Timed mock exams simulating actual Microsoft test conditions
  • Exam strategy sessions — what to focus on, what to skip
  • Post-certification career guidance and LinkedIn optimisation

Topics Covered — AI-900

  • AI workloads and considerations on Azure
  • Machine Learning fundamentals on Azure ML Studio
  • Computer Vision services — Azure Vision, Face, Form Recognizer
  • Natural Language Processing — Azure Language, Speech Services
  • Conversational AI — Azure Bot Service and QnA Maker
  • Responsible AI principles and Microsoft AI guidelines

Topics Covered — DP-900

  • Core data concepts — relational and non-relational data
  • Azure relational data services — SQL Database, PostgreSQL
  • Azure non-relational data — Cosmos DB, Table Storage, Blob Storage
  • Data analytics workloads — Azure Synapse, HDInsight, Databricks
  • Data visualisation with Power BI — reports and dashboards
  • Data engineering fundamentals and pipeline concepts

Your Certification Path

  1. 1

  2. 2

  3. 3

    Domain-specific question banks with explanations for every answer

  4. 4

    Mock Exams

    Timed full-length simulations under actual Microsoft exam conditions

  5. 5

    Certification Day

    Exam strategy session, then you sit the official Microsoft exam

Eligibility & prerequisites

📋

No cloud experience required for AI-900 and DP-900. Basic computer literacy and familiarity with data concepts is helpful. A Microsoft account is required for Azure free tier labs.
